# HSR Utility

> HSR Utility (a brand of HSR Energy Private Limited) builds beautifully designed
> devotional wallpaper and ringtone apps for Android. Its apps are Pakiza (Islamic
> wallpapers and nasheeds) and Arul (South Indian devotional wallpapers and
> ringtones). Both are being prepared for the Google Play Store.

## Key facts

- **Studio:** HSR Utility, a brand of HSR Energy Private Limited, Bengaluru, India. Founded 2026.
- **Apps:**
  - **Pakiza** — HD and live Islamic wallpapers with ringtones and nasheeds.
  - **Arul** — HD and live South Indian devotional wallpapers and ringtones across six deities
    (Amman, Ayyappan, Murugan, Perumal, Sivan, Temples).
- **Model:** Free to browse and preview; an optional premium plan unlocks setting and saving.
- **Sign-in:** Google Sign-In (name, email, profile photo). No phone number or password.
- **Platform:** Android 7.0 (Nougat) and above. No iOS version.
- **Contact:** support@hsrutility.com — replies within 48 hours.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hsrutility.com/): HSR Utility and its two apps, Pakiza and Arul — features and overview.
- [Support & FAQ](https://hsrutility.com/support/): Answers about the apps' content, pricing, sign-in, Android support, and how to report bugs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hsrutility.com/privacy/): What data Pakiza and Arul collect, how it is used, and how it is protected.
- [Delete My Account](https://hsrutility.com/delete-account/): How to permanently delete a Pakiza or Arul account and its associated data.
